  name: hawtio-online
  labels:
    app: hawtio
    deployment: hawtio-online
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: hawtio
      deployment: hawtio-online
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: hawtio
        deployment: hawtio-online
    spec:
      containers:
      - image: hawtio/online:stable

        name: hawtio-online

            port: nginx
            scheme: HTTPS
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 1

          httpGet:

            port: nginx
            scheme: HTTPS

          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 1

            cpu: '0.2'
            memory: 32Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '1.0'
            memory: 100Mi

        - name: hawtio-online
          mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html/online/hawtconfig.json
          subPath: hawtconfig.json
        - name: hawtio-integration

        - name: hawtio-rbac
